headline: Weathered Expanse And Nevish Line Contest Strongpoints In Heavy Clashes
war_summary: Over the past three hours, Weathered Expanse and Nevish Line have driven the bulk of frontline maneuvering, while base exchanges in Linn of Mercy and Marban Hollow paused following intense morning fighting. Weathered Expanse logged five fresh base transitions and mounting casualties, leaving five strategic strongpoints in neutral rubble. Along the western front, Nevish Line recorded four shifts across contested grounds including Mistle Shrine and Princefal, inflicting nearly eighteen hundred combined casualties in the last two hours alone. In Callahan's Passage, fighting around Crumbling Post flared once more with two recent ownership shifts amid heavy attritional losses exceeding sixteen hundred dead. Meanwhile, Marban Hollow, Mooring County, and Linn of Mercy registered no new base changes in the latest two-hour stretch, though casualty rates in Marban Hollow and Linn of Mercy continue to accelerate under persistent shelling. To the east, Stlican Shelf witnessed a sharp rise in casualties despite static base lines.
